description: The Google Fitbit Air is an interesting addition to the wearable segment, especially for people who want detailed health tracking without another screen on their wrist. Its lightweight design, comfortable fabric band, and extensive sleep and fitness monitoring make a strong case for everyday use. The Google Health app brings plenty of useful information, although automatic workout recognition needs refinement, and the AI-powered Health Coach isn't always as helpful as it promises. Battery life goes easily up to seven days, with fast charging adding convenience. Compared to Whoop's subscription-led approach, Fitbit Air is more accessible, with essential health metrics available without Premium. At Rs. 13,999, it's a compelling option for fitness enthusiasts who value simplicity.
title: Fitbit Air Review: Is This Google’s Best Fitness Tracker Yet?

description: SBC, AAC, and LDAC are the three most common codecs. SBC is a widely supported Bluetooth audio codec. AAC is commonly used with Apple devices. LDAC supports higher bitrates of up to 990kbps and audio resolutions of up to 24-bit/96kHz. Here, you can read more about SBC, AAC, and LDAC codecs and decide which Bluetooth codec is best for your headphones.
title: Bluetooth SBC vs AAC vs LDAC: Which Codec Is Better?

description: You can get a travel eSIM from multiple apps that are available via the App Store and Google Play Store that act as alternatives to international roaming packs from your TSPs. The plans offered by travel eSIM platforms are often considered to be cheaper than buying international roaming packs offered by TSPs. However, international roaming is more convenient as it does not require you to activate and configure another SIM on your smartphone. Your TSP will activate international roaming on your existing physical SIM card, which involves fewer steps. Before deciding which travel eSIM app you should download, there are a few things you should keep in mind. You must pick the travel eSIM app based on the coverage it offers. Before downloading the app, check whether the destination you are travelling to is supported by the platform.
title: Best Apps for Travel eSIM in India: How to Choose the Best App, Benefits and More
